name: Shallum
title: Benjamite leader in Jerusalem after the exile
summary: Shallum was a Benjamite who was among the first to settle in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile. He is mentioned in the genealogies in both Nehemiah and 1 Chronicles as a prominent man from the tribe of Benjamin who contributed to the rebuilding of the Jewish community in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Settlement in Jerusalem after the exile
keyEvents.description: Shallum was among the first Benjamites to settle in Jerusalem after returning from the Babylonian exile, helping to repopulate the holy city.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Shallum is listed in the genealogy of the Benjamites who lived in Jerusalem, with his lineage traced through Meshullam.

keyEvents.title: Part of the repopulation of Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: As part of Nehemiah's plan to repopulate Jerusalem, Shallum was among the leading men from Benjamin who moved into the city to strengthen its population.

keyEvents.title: Recording of the lineage
keyEvents.description: Shallum's lineage was carefully recorded to confirm his legitimate belonging to the tribe of Benjamin, which was important for the rebuilt community.
